name: upsert-arms-planned-row-span-clobber
body: Limit: the located (Struct/Function/File) arms CASE-guard only status against a planned incoming row; location and code_type are still written unconditionally in ON MATCH, so a planned located row — if a future delta selection admits one — would clobber the realized node's span with its zero-valued location. Upgrade by CASE-guarding the location/code_type properties in the located arms if a change admits planned located rows into the splice delta.
